accountCreated.subject: Welcome to ShopCore
accountCreated.heading: Your workspace is ready
accountCreated.body: Your ShopCore account and the workspace {{workspace}} were created successfully. You can sign in now and start setting up your business.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your ShopCore password
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your ShopCore account. Choose a new one using the button below. This link expires in one hour.

passwordChanged.subject: Your ShopCore password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Password changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your ShopCore account was changed successfully. Every other device has been signed out. If this was not you, reset your password immediately and contact support.

subscriptionActivated.subject: Your ShopCore subscription is active
subscriptionActivated.heading: Subscription activated
subscriptionActivated.body: Your {{plan}} subscription is now active on a {{cycle}} billing cycle for the workspace {{workspace}}. Thank you for choosing ShopCore.

userInvitedWithCredentials.subject: Your ShopCore account is ready
userInvitedWithCredentials.heading: You've been added to {{workspace}}
userInvitedWithCredentials.body: An account was created for you on the {{workspace}} workspace with the role {{role}}. Sign in with the email {{email}} and the temporary password {{tempPassword}}. You will be asked to choose a new password, then confirm a one-time code, the first time you sign in.

loginOtp.subject: Your ShopCore verification code
loginOtp.heading: Confirm it's you
loginOtp.body: Your one-time verification code is {{code}}. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes. Enter it on the verification screen to finish signing in.
